subject: monta carlo simulation for power with planned missing design

messages.author: e4a3215063481170
messages.subject: monta carlo simulation for power with planned missing design
parts:
Hi list,
 
I am trying to do a power analysis for a planned missing design. Previous research suggested that the Monte Carlo simulation is the recommended way to do this. Can lavaan do this analysis? I know lavaan has a simulateDate() function. Is it the one for this analysis? Any example?
 
Thank you very much.
 
Best regards,
 
ya

messages.author: 5d4f9e7f97c21008
messages.subject: Re: monta carlo simulation for power with planned missing design
parts:
Hi Ya,

I would recommend looking into the simsem package (simsem.org). The package has been designed to simulate data and analyze it for Monte Carlo studies with a variety of different missing mechanisms (including planed missing data designs).

-Alex
